Time travel

Query the lake as it was.

More ways to travel

By time, by lake, and the cost

1
AT (TIMESTAMP => now() - INTERVAL '1 day')
the table as it was one day ago
2
ATTACH 'ducklake:…' AS eth_then (SNAPSHOT_VERSION 2)
the whole lake at one snapshot, read only
3
The cost
old files stay on disk until old snapshots are expired (Lesson 4.4)

Recap

What to remember

1
AT (VERSION => n) reads a table in the past.
2
Any query works on the past.
3
CREATE TABLE … AS SELECT … AT brings data back.
4
The past costs disk until it is expired.
